task: The user-operations folder holds retention files by cohort and month — low activity, new, paying and student users in January; churn warning, existing, high activity and new market in February; low activity and paying again in March. Only the cohorts appearing in more than one month support a genuine month-over-month comparison, so identify those and say plainly which cohorts cannot be compared rather than comparing them anyway. Build a retention curve per cohort and identify the one whose shape departs most from the rest.
